## ICAN v0.1.2 — Channel settings and image API templates

A public ICAN build with the canvas, image/video workflows, account sync, private media and 3D Director. Configure your own API providers; no private supplier configuration or real keys are bundled.

- Fix saving custom-channel and cloud-channel permissions together without converting local storage to S3. Preserve saved storage/channel IDs and credentials.
- Extend explicit image templates with reference URL/Data URL declarations, real multipart image files, raw prompt/size inputs and authenticated same-origin image downloads. Reject redirects and invalid image content.
- Add image tier/custom parameter inputs, use ICAN/Canvas wording and remove the login heading and explanatory subtitle.
- Keep mandatory login, private upload authorization and per-account data isolation.

### Prebuilt image

Platform: **Linux / amd64**. Source: `9b3b8db415e785c7e179e135185f257a016d697b`.

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/ruoyeyu/ican@sha256:4898ff358185dcb049c3460b79d54f2aef8e28239396c9849507d5ba2f3cebc5
```

Put that entire digest in `ICAN_IMAGE` in the existing protected environment file. Use the attached Compose file, environment example and checker. GitHub compiles the image; the production server only pulls and runs it. Runtime limits remain **1.6 CPUs / 1.5 GiB**, with no additional swap.

Before startup, use `docker compose config --quiet`, create with `--no-build`, run the attached policy checker, then start. Follow the full [pull/start/update/rollback instructions](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.md).

### Checks and update

Go tests, 26 Web tests, 294 Director tests, production builds, dependency audits and final-image isolation/restart/runtime/Compose/security checks passed. [CI and publication](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/actions/runs/40110294471). Local browser checks cover login, anonymous upload rejection, account isolation, Director capture and saving both channel switches. Specialized template contracts passed 85 request fixtures; no paid provider calls were made.

The attached `publication.json` binds source, image digest, check run and evidence hashes. Raw scan counts: 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, 0 low; 1 retained UNKNOWN module match for the unimported openpgp package. Keep the complete raw scan and context review; no scan failures or severity filters were bypassed.

Keep the original database/media directory, saved user/API/channel configuration, `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `JWT_SECRET`. This patch adds no database columns. Stop writes and make a consistent full-data backup, with keys backed up separately, before replacing the container.

New optional template syntax requires v0.1.2. To roll back, preserve current data first, restore the old templates and old digest only after checking compatibility; otherwise restore the pre-update backup into a separate directory with its matching keys. Never run two writers against one SQLite directory. Do not clear data or use `down -v`.

This pre-release retains the [resource, session-credential, restore and production acceptance tasks](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/progress/todo.md). It does not deploy or modify a server.

## 简体中文

**ICAN v0.1.2 公共版本**包含本轮渠道设置修复和图片 API 模板扩展。私人供应商配置另行交付，不包含在镜像或仓库里。

- 修复两个渠道权限开关保存时误报存储冲突，保留本地存储类型、稳定 ID 和已有密钥。
- 支持明确的参考图编码、真正的 multipart 文件上传、原始提示词/比例，以及同源鉴权图片下载；拒绝重定向和伪图片。
- 图片面板新增档位和自定义输入；平台品牌改为 ICAN，功能文案用“画布”；登录页删除标题和说明。
- 强制登录、素材权限和账号隔离继续有效。

**服务器无需编译。** 用上面的 digest 拉取镜像，仅修改已有环境文件的 ICAN_IMAGE，保留数据库、媒体、用户/API 配置与原加密/签名密钥。运行上限为 1.6 核、1.5 GiB，不限制 GitHub 编译资源。

Go、Web、导演台、生产构建及最终镜像检查通过；85 组模板请求使用无费用 fixture 验证。真实供应商调用、长任务及生产参考链接可达性仍需实际验收。完整证据、Compose、环境示例、配置检查器和 SHA256 校验文件见附件。

更新前停写并完成一致性备份。旧镜像不支持本次新模板语法，回滚须恢复原模板或匹配的升级前备份，保留升级后的数据副本。本次没有登录或修改服务器。
